newsitem.title: USA: Collins & Aikman sells floorcovering unit.
newsitem.headline: Collins & Aikman sells floorcovering unit.

text.p: Collins & Aikman Corp said Thursday it has sold its floorcoverings business for $195.6 million.
The business was sold to a company formed by Quad-C Inc, a Virginia merchant banking firm, and Paribas Principal Partners, the U.S. private equity unit of Cie Financiere de Paribas.

"We expect to realize about $170 million in net after tax proceeds," Collins & Aikman Chief Executive Thomas Hannah said in a statement. "This will enable us to reduce debt while continuing to concentrate our strategic focus on our core automotive interior trim operations."
Collins & Aikman supplies automotive interior systems.
